description: Markdown source mixes document content with formatting syntax. Markdown Reader provides formatted Preview, exact Raw text, and heading navigation in the same read-only BB file tab. Open workspace, host, and thread-storage files, follow supported links, preview images, and refresh content without editing it. Remote images contact their source servers; no paid account or separate service is required. Requires BB 0.45+ and Plugin SDK >=0.6.15 <0.7; supports UTF-8 text up to 1 MiB, with BB preview available for unsupported files.
